verdict.rationale: Basecamp documents fixed built-in views such as Everything Views, Hill Charts and the global calendar, plus a REST API, OAuth, CLI and MCP support. None of this evidence shows a way for designers to build custom views or dashboard widgets that render natively inside the product. The API is only a developer building block, and the built-in views are adjacent features rather than custom-view extensibility.

support.subject: As a designer, I can build custom views and dashboard widgets that feel native to the product
